title: The pilot-wave dynamics of walking droplets
summary: A short MIT Math Lab video showing millimetric droplets bouncing and walking across a vibrating fluid bath, guided by their own pilot waves. These droplets show diffraction, tunneling and quantized orbits, which were once thought to belong only to quantum systems.
why: Cited in pilot-wave theory threads as a vivid visualization of how quantum-like behavior can arise in a classical system.

quote.text: a nice visualization of the ideas behind the pilot wave/particle system
